title: 2023 Marco Leal interview inconsistency and ICU admission to James

tellings.quote: Well, they're right because I couldn't tell everything even in 2023

plain: A surgeon named Italo Venturelli, from the hospital in Varginha, Brazil, where a creature is said to have been treated, says people who caught gaps in an interview he gave in 2023 to a man named Marco Leal are "right because I couldn't tell everything even in 2023". He tells this himself to Michels, and links it to what he later told the UFO filmmaker James Fox about the hospital's intensive care unit. If true, it would mean he held back part of the story for years and only told more of it later.
